purpose: first held-out 3D problem; same element (Q20, reduced rule), material (nu = 0.45) and curved iso-parametric boundaries as B3, but with an exact solution, so the certified uncertainty can be compared with the TRUE error
adapter_description: Thick-walled cylinder, quarter model in 3D: inner radius 1, outer radius 2, height 0.5, theta in [0, 90 deg]. Compressible neo-Hookean, E = 1000, nu = 0.45 (the B3 material). Inner surface: prescribed displacement u = 0.1 (x, y, 0); outer surface free; symmetry planes y = 0 and x = 0; rollers u_z = 0 on z = 0 and z = 0.5. 20-node hexahedra (torch-fem Hexa2, its default reduced rule, as B3) with every node on the exact geometry; levels (n_r, n_theta, n_z) = k (2, 4, 1), k = 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 (h = 1/k); strategies at k = 4: radial grading toward the inner surface, exponent 1.5 and 2.0. QoIs: strain_energy; reaction_inner_radial = |sum of inner-node reactions . e_r|; u_outer_radial = u_x at (2, 0, 0); gk_avg_hoop = hoop Cauchy stress averaged with exp(-(d/0.2)^2), d the distance to (1, 0, 0.25); disc_avg_hoop = its mean over the Gauss points with d < 0.3; peak_hoop = max hoop stress over all Gauss points.

exact_for_scoring_only.note: peak_hoop = hoop Cauchy stress at r = A (the maximum, hoop stress decreases with r); radial_stress_at_B should be ~0 (traction-free)

scoring_tests.T1 rule predictions: the unchanged rules predict PASS for strain_energy, reaction_inner_radial, u_outer_radial and nothing for the three stress quantities; hits counted as before
scoring_tests.T2 coverage of the true error: for every quantity the agent passes with RATE evidence: |exact - certified limit| <= U_fine x scale (the agent's own uncertainty). Counted per quantity; no tolerance added
scoring_tests.T3 finest-level error inside U: secondary: |exact - finest value| compared with |certified limit - finest value| + U x scale
scoring_tests.T4 final status: crosscheck v2 has no independent discretization here, so every rate-certified quantity is single_family -> INCONCLUSIVE (final); T2 says whether that caution was needed

developer_expectations.strain_energy: PASS rate; fitted order 3-5; T2 holds
developer_expectations.gk_avg_hoop: PASS rate; T2 holds (smooth weight, smooth field); MEDIUM confidence
developer_expectations.disc_avg_hoop: PASS, band or rate (sharp region cut by elements: irregular convergence); if rate, T2 holds with LOW confidence
developer_expectations.peak_hoop: PASS rate with an order near 1 (Gauss points approach the inner wall at O(h)), limit below the exact surface value only by the fit error; T2 holds with LOW confidence
developer_expectations.overall: at least 5 of 6 quantities PASS; T2 holds for every rate-certified quantity. A T2 failure would show that one-family certification can miss the true error even on a smooth 3D problem with this element
